question: Скільки всього електроенергії (кВт·год) спожили побутові споживачі за січень 2026?
raw: SELECT sum(f.energy_kwh) FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_consumer_class k USING (class_key) WHERE k.class_label = 'Побутовий споживач'
sql: SELECT sum(f.energy_kwh) FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_consumer_class k USING (class_key) WHERE k.class_label = 'Побутовий споживач'
final_sql: SELECT SUM(f.energy_kwh) FROM fact_consumption AS f JOIN dim_consumer_class AS k USING (class_key) WHERE k.class_label = 'Побутовий споживач' LIMIT 200
gold_sql: SELECT sum(f.energy_kwh) FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_consumer_class k USING (class_key) WHERE k.class_label = 'Побутовий споживач'

question: Яка частка енергії комерційних споживачів припадає на пікові години, у відсотках?
raw: SELECT 100 * sum(f.energy_kwh) FILTER (WHERE h.is_peak) / sum(f.energy_kwh) FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_hour h USING (hour_key) JOIN dim_consumer_class k USING (class_key) WHERE k.class_label = 'Комерційний споживач'
sql: SELECT 100 * sum(f.energy_kwh) FILTER (WHERE h.is_peak) / sum(f.energy_kwh) FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_hour h USING (hour_key) JOIN dim_consumer_class k USING (class_key) WHERE k.class_label = 'Комерційний споживач'
final_sql: SELECT 100 * SUM(f.energy_kwh) FILTER(WHERE h.is_peak) / SUM(f.energy_kwh) FROM fact_consumption AS f JOIN dim_hour AS h USING (hour_key) JOIN dim_consumer_class AS k USING (class_key) WHERE k.class_label = 'Комерційний споживач' LIMIT 200
gold_sql: SELECT 100 * sum(f.energy_kwh) FILTER (WHERE h.is_peak) / sum(f.energy_kwh) FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_hour h USING (hour_key) JOIN dim_consumer_class k USING (class_key) WHERE k.class_label = 'Комерційний споживач'

question: Скільки годин споживач Consumer_3310 перевищував договірний ліміт?
raw: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE load_kw > lim) FROM (SELECT f.consumer_key, f.date_key, f.hour_key, sum(f.energy_kwh) AS load_kw, any_value(c.contract_limit_kw) AS lim FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_consumer c USING (consumer_key) WHERE c.consumer_id = 'Consumer_3310' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3)
sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE load_kw > lim) FROM (SELECT f.consumer_key, f.date_key, f.hour_key, sum(f.energy_kwh) AS load_kw, any_value(c.contract_limit_kw) AS lim FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_consumer c USING (consumer_key) WHERE c.consumer_id = 'Consumer_3310' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3)
final_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE load_kw > lim) FROM (SELECT f.consumer_key, f.date_key, f.hour_key, SUM(f.energy_kwh) AS load_kw, ANY_VALUE(c.contract_limit_kw) AS lim FROM fact_consumption AS f JOIN dim_consumer AS c USING (consumer_key) WHERE c.consumer_id = 'Consumer_3310' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3) LIMIT 200
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE load_kw > lim) FROM (SELECT f.consumer_key, f.date_key, f.hour_key, sum(f.energy_kwh) AS load_kw, any_value(c.contract_limit_kw) AS lim FROM fact_consumption f JOIN dim_consumer c USING (consumer_key) WHERE c.consumer_id = 'Consumer_3310' GROUP BY 1, 2, 3)

question: Яка середня температура була в Закарпатській області 11 січня 2026 року?
